title: PackReadinessAcknowledgedPayload
description: Payload of the PackReadinessAcknowledged platform event (catalogued in model/architecture/events.yaml, INV-NOTE-3 §19.8, §5.5, §28.18; class: platform; FR-AH.15). Authored by INV-T-2855 (T11), moved here from the per-producer copy INV-T-2853 (T9) first added (STK-61: a platform event's schema is owned by service-runtime alone). Within a major version this schema is additive-only (API-41, FR-K.4): a field is never removed, renamed, retyped or made required.

packIdentifier.description: The rule pack identifier being acknowledged.

version.description: The rule pack version being acknowledged.

instance.description: The acknowledging service instance (this producer's own instanceid).

failureReason.description: Why the load failed, present when outcome is FAILED.
